Primary request: remove ONLY (1) the books from the wood shelf and (2) the entire children's train/play table including the trains, toy landscape and loose toys underneath the table. The client has physically removed these items since this photograph was taken. Leave the existing wood shelf empty and extend the immediately surrounding existing wall/carpet behind the removed objects, matching perspective, carpet stripes, natural lighting and shadows. No replacement furniture or decorations.
Invariants: preserve the original full composition, original 800:533 aspect ratio, viewpoint, framing, furniture, chairs, ottomans, fireplace, window frames, TV, ceiling, floor, wall art, doorways, reception counter, plants and any people. Preserve all existing signs/logos/text exactly as in the input. Do not redesign, renovate or beautify the office. Do not change any person's appearance. Do not change color grading or lighting. Changes should be limited strictly to the obsolete books and train/play table and the small areas they occluded. Return one edited photograph, no labels, no border, no before/after layout.
